identity.name: Attesa Chrono Satellite Wave GPS
identity.one_liner: The Citizen Attesa Chrono Satellite Wave — 43.5mm titanium, GPS satellite time sync, eco-drive solar, perpetual calendar, chronograph.

provenance_events.description: Citizen releases the Attesa Chrono Satellite Wave GPS as a 43.5mm titanium chronograph with GPS satellite time sync.

narrative.story: The Attesa is Citizen's high-end sport-luxury line — titanium, GPS satellite time sync, eco-drive (no battery changes), perpetual calendar, chronograph.
narrative.collector_notes: The H145 movement is one of the most tech-loaded in any watch at this price: GPS satellite time sync, eco-drive, perpetual calendar, 24-hour chronograph.
